# Evaluation summary (generated by eval/run_eval.py)

Sessions used: 13. Arms: A (Fixed menu, generic profile), B (Dwell selection (no blink)), C (Calibrated, no adaptation), D (Calibrated + rule policy).
Arm E (supervisor agent) not run in this pass: use --agent api.
Fatigue rows are simulated (recorded head movement scaled down to 50% over the session).
How to read this: each recorded session is replayed open loop through every setup. A replay cannot show how the person would have reacted to a different layout, so counts like messages spoken compare setups only roughly, and task metrics are meaningful only for sessions recorded with a scripted task. abstention_correct is the share of 2-second windows with low signal quality in which nothing was selected.
